title: malus × scheideckeri
intro: Malus × scheideckeri, commonly known as Scheidecker's crabapple, is a hybrid plant species within the Rosaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
